contexts.text: Unless the Lord withheld man... he would cast himself headlong into Hell... AC 2335:2. AC 2406:2. AC 2410. AC 5854:2. AC 7479.
The Angels plainly perceive that they are withheld by the Lord from rushing into Hell... AC 5758.

When a man has been regenerated, he is withheld from the evil and falsity in him... There is a strong withholding from evil and falsity... and as the man is withheld from evil and falsity, he cannot destroy himself; but if let go in the least... he would rush into all evil and falsity.
All men, Spirits, and Angels are continually withheld from Hell by the Lord.
Evil is not separated from the Angels, there is merely a withholding from it, AC 4295:2.
The Angels confess that they are withheld from their evil and falsity... AC 2116:2.
When man is withheld from evil... he supposes there is nothing but good in him...
The infants (there) are also (merely) withheld from evil...
The second state (of the Church Lot) that they are powerfully withheld from evils, and kept in goods, by the Lord. Treated of. AC 2406. AC 2411, Signified.
When the Church begins to fall away... they are more strongly withheld from evil... than when it is in the good of charity. Signified.
All men whatever are withheld from evils... by a stronger force than can be believed.
The Lord, by the good He insinuates, withholds man.
Their state when withheld from falsity and evil. Signified.
They who can be reformed... are held back in affection of good and thought of truth...
Nothing is blotted out; men and Angels are (merely) withheld from evil... AC 4564:2. AC 4721:2. AC 9451. AC 9937:4. NJHD 166. DP 79:2. DP 279:3, Described. TCR 614. SE 3085. AE 478.
A withholding from these things. Signified, Explained.
Man withheld by external bonds.
(A regenerate man) retains in himself the inclination to evil... but is withheld by the influx of the life of the Lord's love...
A man who would profane is withheld as far as possible from the acknowledgement... of truth and good. AC 4289.
Those who profane cannot be withheld.
His Own will is miraculously separated by a higher force, by which he is withheld from evil, and held in good.
They detain the mind of another in one (idea).
For they can no longer be withheld.
From himself, man is in Hell, but from the Lord's mercy he is withheld from evil and held in good, and this by a strong force.
If thou detain them () = to keep on infesting; for they who are being infested are detained (or held) by the evil Spirits... They hold him as it were bound. Explained.
It is not meant that they are without evil, but that they are withheld from evil in good...
A withholding then from earthly and worldly things. Signified, Explained.
That they are withheld in goods by the Lord. Signified, Explained.
That they are then withheld from all evil and falsity. Signified.
That they were withheld from falsities on every side. Signified, Explained.

That man is withheld from evil and falsity by being held in good and truth by the Lord. References. But no one can be withheld from evil, and held in good, unless, by the exercise of charity in the world, he has received the capacity of it.
That they should be withheld from the evils of those in faith alone... Signified, Explained.
For the Lord does not take away evil, but withholds the man from it, and holds him in good. References.
For man can be withheld from evil (there) in proportion as he has resisted it (here).
Those of the Spiritual Church... are withheld from evils, and held in good, by the Lord.
Then evils are remitted; for the man is then held in truths and goods... and withheld from evils.
As far as possible, the Lord withholds man from the conjunction of truth and good with falsity and evil.
In so far as a man can be withheld from what is his Own, the Lord can be present.
The remission of sins (consists merely) in being withheld from them by the Lord, when the man is such that he can be held in good and truth... AC 9448.

Those who have led a life of faith and charity, can (there) be withheld from evils, and held in good; but as those who... have led a life of the love of self and the world cannot be withheld from evils... they sink down into Hell.

Those who have been regenerated... are withheld from evils and falsities; whereas those who do not suffer themselves to be regenerated... are also withheld from evil... but the infernal loves... in which they are... turn the influx of good into evil...
No one can be withheld from evil and held in good but he who is in the good of faith and charity...

All in Heaven are withheld from what is their Own; and, in proportion as they are withheld from it by the Lord, in the same proportion they are in love and wisdom; but in proportion as they are not withheld from it, they are in the love of self. HH 591. HH 595. TCR 121:2.
With the Angels, Heaven consists in being withheld from what is their Own.

Thus it is the Lord alone who thus withholds from evil, Heaven, the World of Spirits, and the human race; insomuch that if [the power] were relaxed everyone would rush into enormous evil and all destruction.
These bonds do not appear to the Spirits and men... for they do not perceive that they are so withheld...
So that there is merely a withholding from evil, which is induced by vastations... (See SE 4197.)
